title: Batwoman Rebirth Lot of 8 DC 2017 #3 4 5 6 7 8 9 11 Bennett Tynion Scarecrow
condition_description: Covers clean and bright; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear; #7 shows some spine and edge wear. See photos.
description:

- #4 (Aug 2017) - Kali cover
- #5 (Sep 2017) - "Before She Was Batwoman... Kate Kane Broke Bad!"
- #6 (Oct 2017) - "Pax Batmana"
- #7 (Nov 2017) - "Fear and Loathing" Part One, Scarecrow
- #8 (Dec 2017) - "Fear and Loathing", "Duel in the Desert!"
- #9 (Jan 2018) - "Fear and Loathing"
- #11 (Mar 2018) - "Paging Professor Pyg!"

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
